other_conditions: Applicant must hold a Ph.D. in Science and Engineering from a recognized Indian institution (MBBS/MD degrees and Veterinary doctors are also eligible)
Applicant must have a permanent position in an Indian research or academic institution
Applicants with a Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE) award are eligible
Letter of support from the overseas host institution must be submitted
Age relaxation of 5 years is provided for SC, ST, OBC, physically challenged and women candidates
benefits_summary: Fellows receive a $3,000 per month fellowship, a one‑time ₹75,000 contingency allowance, ₹20,000 medical insurance, and economy class airfare for up to six months.
documents_required: Letter of support from overseas host institution
Endorsement letter signed by the head of the applicant’s organization/institute
Research plan PDF (uploaded as a single file)
